_how: Lives in the site root next to the CSVs. One TradingView 'List of trades' CSV per variant x risk (knightfall-v1-400.csv etc.). Set the paths, set 'end' to the last trade date to publish, then run from the site root: python3 build_results.py --config results-config.json --out results-data.js. A null path keeps that profile's published numbers unchanged.

v1.label: Variant 1 — Stock
v1.note: Variant 1 settings: the original Knightfall exits. Takes profit at TP1.

v2.label: Variant 2 — Runner
v2.note: Variant 2 settings: full size held for TP2, trailing stop starts at TP1, stop capped at the far ORB edge.
